description: MammothOS MCP server registry. Each entry maps to a config file in this directory. Set enabled=false to disable without removing the config. Each config's access field (admin|tenant) controls who can see its tools in Mammoth Mind agent runs.

servers.label: Browser (Playwright)
servers.description: Headed Chromium automation with persistent auth profile. Provides navigate, snapshot, click, fill, screenshot, and extract tools.

servers.label: Filesystem (Repo)
servers.description: Owner/admin only, platform repo scope only. Lets Mammoth Mind inspect project files; mutating calls require approval. Secrets are denied.

servers.label: Git
servers.description: Owner/admin only, platform repo scope only. Status, diff, log, and branch inspection; mutating calls require approval and git_push is never exposed.
